fonts.display: 'SuisseIntlCond', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'SuisseIntl', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Carbon Black
palette.role: Primary text, inverted card surfaces, filled blocks — the structural dark that anchors the monochrome system

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Card surfaces, inverted text on dark blocks, icon fills — the bright counterpoint to carbon black

palette.name: Warm Canvas
palette.role: Page background, hero backdrop, section dividers — the slightly warm gray that distinguishes this from a clinical white canvas

palette.name: Mist Gray
palette.role: Secondary surface, nav pill backgrounds, subtle panels — one step lighter than canvas for quiet layering

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Borders, hairlines, disabled states — mid-tone neutral for structural lines

palette.name: Smoke
palette.role: Body text secondary, meta labels, icon strokes — the muted text level for non-emphasized content

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Secondary body text, navigation labels, and subdued headings. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Deep surface for code blocks or heavy accents — near-black alternative

palette.name: Mint Chip
palette.role: Link backgrounds, tag pills, accent highlights — the signature pale green that punctuates the monochrome system

palette.name: Voltage Yellow
palette.role: Email highlights, small accent dots, decorative bursts — the high-energy chromatic note on micro-elements
